incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> inference-dispatcher queue backlog (SEV2)

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Trigger: high_queue_backlog_inference-dispatcher; severity: 2; service: inference; description: queue length > 20k for 5m; runbook: https://runbooks.internal/inference/queue-backlog

Eli: ack
Eli: I'm on it, looking at autoscaler metrics and node provisioning

Sarah: I'm seeing 5xx spikes in the EU region, ~600 errors/min for the past 4m. Latency p50 increased to 450ms, p95 2.1s

Mike: autoscaler reports desired=12 current=6, pending nodes=4, but cloud provider shows provisioning stuck in 'allocating' for 7m. possibility: spot shortage or quota

Anita: any recent rollout? configs? I didn't push anything

Eli: no recent deployments. checking controller logs

Eli: logs: ```time="10:04:12" level=warn msg="scale-up attempt failed: node request rejected: InsufficientInstanceCapacity"```

Mike: yep, Incapacity. Cloud suggests fallback to on-demand. I'm going to force a manual scale to on-demand node pool and set replicas to 20 to drain backlog while we sort spots

Eli: doing manual scale of deployment to relieve queue. Command:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-dispatcher --replicas=20
gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize inference-pool-on-demand --size=12
``` 

Anita: also enabling temporary bypass: route low-priority batch jobs to a cheaper fallback model (model-small) to preserve capacity for prod real-time

pagerduty: PagerDuty: ack by Eli

Eli: scaled to 20 replicas, pods are coming up. monitoring queue length

Sarah: queue fell from 22k -> 9k in 3m after scale, errors down to 120/min. Still seeing some nodes stuck in provisioning (2)

Mike: cloud support engaged, raising quota request and forcing two on-demand nodes. ETA ~4m.

Eli: mitigation working, but root cause likely spot capacity evaporation in eu-west1. Will file a ticket to add fallback instance type and improve scaling policy

Anita: taking note to add autoscaler fallback to on-demand after X failed attempts. also add alert for "provisioning stuck" so we don't only detect queue

Eli: customer impact: partial degradation for EU customers; about 2-3% of requests hit 5xx during 10:03-10:12 window. I alerted support to message affected customers if needed

Lina: I'm next oncall in 45m, will take over monitoring. Summary for handoff:
- Incident: high queue backlog due to spot capacity shortage
- Mitigation: manual scale to on-demand node pool, scaled deployment to 20 replicas, routed low-priority jobs to fallback model
- Status: queue down to 3.2k, errors at baseline, 2 nodes still provisioning with cloud
- Next actions: confirm on-demand nodes fully up, file infra ticket, add autoscaler fallback policy

Eli: handing off to Lina. Logs/graphs: https://dashboards.redwood/inference/queue?from=2026-03-15T10:00

Lina: ack, taking over. tagging oncall rotation: @pagerduty

Eli: closing thread for now, will reopen if metrics regress :thumbsup:
